name: x-automation
description: TypeScript utilities for X.com (Twitter) - browser console scripts for liking and unmuting

scripts.build: bun build src/like.ts --outdir dist --minify --target browser --format iife && bun build src/unmute.ts --outdir dist --minify --target browser --format iife
scripts.build:dev: bun build src/like.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife && bun build src/unmute.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife
scripts.minify: echo 'Minification now handled by bun build --minify'
scripts.rebuild: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.like: bun build src/like.ts --outdir dist --minify --target browser --format iife && pbcopy < dist/like.js && echo '✅ Built and copied like.js to clipboard!'
scripts.unmute: bun build src/unmute.ts --outdir dist --minify --target browser --format iife && pbcopy < dist/unmute.js && echo '✅ Built and copied unmute.js to clipboard!'
scripts.unfollow: bun build src/unfollow-inactive.ts --outdir dist --minify --target browser --format iife && pbcopy < dist/unfollow-inactive.js && echo '✅ Built and copied unfollow-inactive.js to clipboard!'
